Nina: Tiny kitchen PSA: someone left a squirt bottle of pancake syrup open in the cereal shelf. Found ants? maybe small sticky trail. :ant: :grimacing:
Evan: Ack. I noticed a faint sticky smell earlier but thought it was someones lunch. I'll bring cleaning spray.
Priya: Also can we stop using masking tape for labels? It peels off and gets smudged. Clear label roll would be ideal.
Sam: Agree. I can pick up a roll and a small label printer on my way home tonight. Anyone prefer matte vs glossy?
Nina: Glossy sticks better but smudges. Matte is easier to write on. I'd choose glossy for jars, matte for paper notes.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: "Fridge cleanout" scheduled this Saturday at 11am. Reaction ":thumbsup:" to join.
Evan: I'll join for cleanout. Quick ask: if you open a shared bottle, please mark date opened. helps with milk/oat milk confusion.
Priya: Proposed label fields: Item | Opened | Owner (optional) | EMPTY checkbox. I'll make a tiny printable PDF.
Sam: Label printer + supplies -> done. I'll leave a note in kitchen with setup instructions.
Nina: Also: who took the little maple travel bottle? It was on the counter and now gone. :eyes:
Evan: Not me. People hide condiments in drawers like theyre treasure.
Priya: Weekly snack run poll: Fridays? :one: yes :two: no
Nina: :one:
Evan: :one:
Sam: :one: 
Priya: Looks like Fridays win. I'll post a signup sheet. Thanks all. :coffee: "
